BiblicalUsage: Sid is lime, the white plaster of walls and the burning of bones. Moab burned the bones of the king of Edom into lime, the stones of the altar on Ebal were plastered with it, and the prophet says the peoples shall be as the burnings of lime, thorns cut up and burned in the fire.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe lime is what is left when the fire has done its work, and judgment leaves nothing to rebuild with but the Lord's mercy.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
